sources.title: onsemi NCP1117ST50T3G
sources.ref: NCP1117/D Rev. 29, July 2018. Electrical Characteristics, TA = 25 C. Output voltage 5.000 V typical. Dropout (Vout - 100 mV) 0.95 V at 0.1 A, 1.01 V at 0.5 A, 1.07 V at 0.8 A (1.20 V max at 0.8 A). Figure 5 is the curve; these three table points are the knots. Output current limit (Vin - Vout = 5 V) 1.5 A typical (1.0 A min, 2.2 A max). Note 6: do not exceed 1.0 A with Vin above 12 V. Load regulation of the 5.0 V part, Iout 0 to 0.8 A, Vin = 6.5 V: 6.7 mV typical. Quiescent current of the 5.0 V part, Vin = 15 V: 0.006 A typical

sources.title: Dropout outside the table, reverse path
sources.ref: Assumed flat dropout below 0.1 A and above 0.8 A. rOut is 6.7 mV / 0.8 A. The internal reverse diode is documented as a surge (about 15 A for 100 us) with no DC law, so it is omitted
